content.text: All checks pass. Let's view the final file to confirm correctness.

The bug was that `app/(site)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx` had no `generateMetadata`, so every post page fell back to the layout's default title (`"tsuzuri"`) — the `<h1>` showed the right translated title, but the browser tab didn't. I added a `generateMetadata` export that resolves the same locale-matched translation (via `resolveTranslation`, reusing the existing `acceptedLocales` helper) and sets `title` to it, which also picks up the layout's `"%s · tsuzuri"` template. Typecheck, lint, and the existing Jest suite all pass.
